data.text: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy assembly. You shall do no ordinary work. It shall be a day of trumpet blasts for you.
You shall offer a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs a year old without blemish,
with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, about six quarts for the bull and about four quarts for the ram,
and about two quarts for each lamb, for each of the seven lambs,
and one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

These are in addition to the monthly burnt offering and its grain offering, and the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, with their drink offerings according to their rule, as a pleasing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy assembly. You shall humble yourselves and do no work.
You shall present a burnt offering to the LORD as a pleasing aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs a year old. They shall be without blemish.
Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil, about six quarts for the bull and about four quarts for the ram,
about two quarts for each lamb, for each of the seven lambs,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, with their drink offerings.
On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy assembly. You shall do no ordinary work, and you shall keep a feast to the LORD for seven days.
data.titulo: Offerings for the Feast of Booths

data.text: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old. They shall be without blemish.
Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil, about six quarts for each of the thirteen bulls and about four quarts for each of the two rams,
and about two quarts for each lamb, for each of the fourteen lambs,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
On the second day, twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old without blemish,
with their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs, according to their number, according to the rule,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, with their drink offerings.
On the third day, eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old without blemish,
with their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs, according to their number, according to the rule,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, with its drink offering.
On the fourth day, ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old without blemish,
their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs, according to their number, according to the rule,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
On the fifth day, nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old without blemish,
with their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs, according to their number, according to the rule,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, with its drink offering.
On the sixth day, eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old without blemish,
with their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs, according to their number, according to the rule,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offerings.
On the seventh day, seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs a year old without blemish,
with their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs, according to their number, according to their rule,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no ordinary work.
data.titulo: The Solemn Assembly on the Eighth Day

data.text: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire, as a pleasing aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, and seven lambs a year old without blemish,
their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, the ram, and the lambs, according to their number, according to the rule,
and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, with its drink offering.

You shall offer these to the LORD at your appointed times, in addition to your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, your grain offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”
Moses spoke to the Israelites according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses.
